line.text: Well, it’s your fault the Holy Mother even approved working directly against you in the first place,

currentParagraphDialogue.text: Well, it’s your fault the Holy Mother even approved working directly against you in the first place,

paragraphContext.currentParagraphText: “Well, it’s your fault the Holy Mother even approved working directly against you in the first place,” the Augur shrugged, making Jake look at him confused.

nextParagraphDialogue.text: I guess I should clarify... the Holy Mother never thought you would lose. She saw our Tutorial and, from what I heard, a few of your Nevermore exploits. More than that, she knows the Malefic Viper,

If the Holy Church had operated with the assumption that you and the Malefic Viper would obviously defeat Yip of Yore and Ell’Hakan, it could have given away the schemes of your Patron. That’s why the Holy Mother allowed the internal faction to run wild despite her knowing how much of a waste it is. Besides, on the off-chance Ell’Hakan did somehow win, she would already have hedged her bet.

paragraphContext.nextParagraphText: “I guess I should clarify... the Holy Mother never thought you would lose. She saw our Tutorial and, from what I heard, a few of your Nevermore exploits. More than that, she knows the Malefic Viper,” Jacob explained. “If the Holy Church had operated with the assumption that you and the Malefic Viper would obviously defeat Yip of Yore and Ell’Hakan, it could have given away the schemes of your Patron. That’s why the Holy Mother allowed the internal faction to run wild despite her knowing how much of a waste it is. Besides, on the off-chance Ell’Hakan did somehow win, she would already have hedged her bet.”

previousParagraphDialogue.text: You know, despite your negative outlook, I do think there could have been some kind of compromise if you’d simply been straightforward and not actively worked against me.

paragraphContext.previousParagraphText: “So you’re the backup, huh?” Jake said. “You know, despite your negative outlook, I do think there could have been some kind of compromise if you’d simply been straightforward and not actively worked against me.”
